rationale: All 60 dependencies preserve the intended G(n,p) law, ordinary degree, asymptotic n-to-infinity regime, and simultaneous all-vertices event. The eventual d≤C premise is an explicit witness form of d=O(1), and the conclusion preserves the displayed log n/log log n scale and 0.9 benchmark. The proposition is stronger than the literal source claim because it fixes the hidden output coefficient to C+5 and uses a strict bound; the source's big-O wording alone does not entail that exact coefficient. The premises are satisfiable, so this is genuine strength rather than vacuity or reduced applicability.
